captureContract.inputInjection: PostMessageW(WM_KEYDOWN, vkCode, 0x00000001) + PostMessageW(WM_KEYUP, vkCode, 0xc0000001) to the PID-filtered Chocolate Doom window handle; SetForegroundWindow is called before each key burst so SDL 1.2's message pump processes the synthesized events.
captureContract.saveDirectoryOverride: -savedir <sandbox-absolute-path> command-line flag redirects DOOMSAV<N>.DSG into the sandbox cwd instead of the default %APPDATA% subtree.
captureContract.liveCaptureGate: test/plan_final/oracle/capture-reference-save-load.test.ts pins the static surface (runner + buildSaveSlotFilename + SAVE_LOAD_DEFAULT_SLOT + SAVE_LOAD_TRACE_ORDINALS frozen 10-element list + SAVE_LOAD_TRACE_NAMES frozen 10-element list mirroring the plan_fps capture-live-save-load-roundtrip.json `expectedTrace[*].action` field + override key set + both error class shapes) and gates the live capture on `referenceBundleIsAvailable()`; when gated in, the live test spawns a fresh sandboxed DOOM.EXE with `-savedir <sandbox>`, navigates Main → Episode → Skill → E1M1, saves to slot 0 via F2/Enter/Enter, mutates state with a 50-tic VK_UP hold (asserting mutated frame hash diverges from pre-save baseline), loads slot 0 via F3/Enter, re-reads the .DSG bytes (asserting byte-identical roundtrip), captures verify-restored frame, kills DOOM, and asserts clean sandbox cleanup.
